claims.assertion: Mari describes starship time travel as changing the vessel’s gravity-mass-energy pattern to match a destination; she equates this with becoming vibrationally compatible with that place and time.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She interprets ship technology as an imitation of consciousness.

claims.assertion: Mari says multiple pasts and futures continue to exist and claims mind alone can revisit a time by matching its frequency, without a spacecraft.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She presents time and space as mental perceptions.
